item.title: Launching ONLINE FIRST
item.description: Dear collaborators,After we will publish the issue 23 of our journal, at the end of this month, our team will promote a new possibility of rapid publishing for interested authors. It is about ONLINE FIRST system, which will allow the authors to get their papers published ahead of the terms of our biannual timeframe (July and December). item.title: New template
item.description: We are thrilled to unveil a significant update to the article format for SCECO Journal. Moving forward, all submissions must adhere to a new mandatory structure that encompasses all specific sections integral to a scientific article. This enhancement aims to streamline the submission process, ensure consistency, and elevate the quality of published research.
